observations.why: The speaker enacts authority-ranking by declaring a decision for the group — 'we are adopting' performs a binding choice on behalf of the collective.
The relational move is proportionality — justifying the adoption through a cost-benefit metric, a market-pricing framing of the decision.
The speaker commits the group to a timeline, enacting authority-ranking by unilaterally setting a schedule others are expected to follow.
The summary recapitulates both the market-pricing proportionality ('15x improvement') and the authority-ranking commitment ('Migration starts Q3 2026') in compressed form.
